rationale: No existing E2E spec covers the pipe-preservation behavior after legacy pipe-syntax removal. The matchall spec tests general match_all queries but does NOT test whether pipes inside quoted terms are preserved (the core change). The logsqueries.spec.js test list covers various query features but none of its tests exercise pipe-bearing match_all terms. The removal of pipe-splitting from useQuery.ts, SearchBar.vue, IndexList.vue, and Traces files is a fresh behavioral change — it demands a dedicated spec. This is a 'new' action per the spec_path in run-context.json (logsqueries.pipeDeprecation.spec.js). The spec must be registered in ci_matrix.json under the Logs-Core group alongside sibling logsqueries.* specs. Note: the diff also touches Traces (Index.vue, IndexList.vue, SearchBar.vue, filterUtils.ts). Traces pipe-preservation E2E tests are NOT planned here (the run focuses on the Logs area per triage); they remain a known gap for a follow-up.
